messages:
Carmen: Quick request  Spectral.ai is planning a hosted PoC spike next Friday 13:00-13:20 PT. They will run a distributed runner (approx 170 clients ~11 rps). Can we provide a scoped API key, a temporary token quota increase, and an IP allowlist? Org: org-spectral-07.
Diego: Can you confirm model + average tokens per call? Need tokens/min to size safely.
Carmen: Theyre calling /v1/generate using redwood-2.0-large. Average end-to-end payload ~= 410 tokens. Rough calc: 170 * 11 * 410 = ~767k tokens/min peak. Theyd like a conservative cap of 900k tokens/min for a 25-minute window.
Sasha: That maps to ~12.8k tokens/sec. Us-west-2 pool can take that if we reserve capacity. Recommend token_quota_per_minute=900000, concurrent_request_limit=280, and a valid_window with a 10m buffer: 2026-12-03T20:50:00Z/2026-12-03T21:15:00Z. Also suggest setting a spend cap on the key so the PoC can't blow the budget.
Jules: Security wants scoped key only (no org master), IP allowlist mandatory, redact prompts in logs, retention 4 days for this key, and no export of logs off-platform. Please provide a named contact for DSR questions.
Carmen: Contact is clara@spectral.ai. Yes to a billing cap; they requested $750 max. Also prefer graceful degradation over hard errors; route to a quantized variant if saturated.
Diego: We can attach routing_policy to the key: fallback_model=redwood-1.3-small and emit a header X-RW-ModelUsed. We'll also enable an observability rule that auto-throttles the key if cross-customer 5xx > 0.9% for 5m.
Sasha: Ill reserve the capacity and create the scoped key once IP ranges arrive. Example admin call Ill run (admin token required):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org-spectral-07","name":"spectral-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":900000,"concurrent_request_limit":280,"valid_window":"2026-12-03T20:50:00Z/2026-12-03T21:15:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-ModelUsed"},"billing_caps":{"currency":"USD","spend_limit":"750"}}'
```
infra-bot: ACTION: reserved capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "spectral-poc-burst"  ticket INF-9124  reserved 1000 rps-equivalent.
Jules: Security checklist items: mask fields prompt_text and user_email, retention 96h, exports disabled. I will sign off after IP ranges and confirmation that logs are masked.
Carmen: IP ranges DMd to Jules. Would like the key delivered securely and a one-pager with expected cost estimate.
Diego: Key will be created and delivered to the PoC contact via secure vault. Ill also attach a dashboard and set an alert: page on 5xx > 1% for 3m OR median latency > 550ms. If the alert fires well throttle or abort the window.
Sasha: Scoped key created: sk_spectral_poc_2023. Token quota=900000/min, concurrent cap=280, retention=96h, fallback configured, spend_limit=$750. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc/spectral-2023.
Carmen: Thanks team  please monitor during the window and call out any cross-customer impact. Ill post post-test metrics and cost summary here.
Jules: Security sign-off complete. Logs masked, exports disabled.
Carmen: Closing loop after the test. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :rocket:
